operations.evidence: CAPI checks were limited to programmed rules and software-version metadata remained required.
Whole-sample core modules, subsample modules and self-completion modules were preserved as different questionnaire bases.
Variables from different routing bases were not compared without denominator metadata.
Complex-design variance, household-personal covariance and 95 percent confidence intervals were recorded.
Sampling intervals were not used as measures of all survey error and significance remained comparison-specific.
Address selection, address nonresponse, dwelling, individual-selection and incident-series weight components were preserved.
Weight names were not used without the edition formula and applicable sample definition.
Age, sex and region population controls used in calibration were recorded.
Calibration balance was not represented as correction of unknown within-group differences.
Pre-2002 event-year and post-2002 interview-year label semantics were preserved.
Year labels were not treated as semantically constant and interview-time attitude measures remained separate.
Don't-know and refusal responses were recorded as generally excluded from analysis unless specified.
Missing responses were not converted to negative answers and table-note exceptions remained required.
Published incident estimates rounded to the nearest 1,000 were recorded.
Rounded estimates were not represented as exact observations or reused for precise derived calculations.
Response rates of 46 percent in years ending March 2024 and 2025 versus around 70 percent before the pandemic were recorded.
Response-rate change was not treated as direct proof of estimate bias and period calculation consistency remained required.
Initial main-survey participation and approximately annual telephone follow-up waves were recorded.
Experimental telephone panel results were not merged with standard cross-sectional face-to-face results without mode metadata.
Cumulative response decline and nonrandom demographic and socioeconomic attrition were recorded.
Panel outputs retained wave-specific representativeness and attrition uncertainty.
The limit of weighting for unobserved or behaviourally driven responder differences was recorded.
Known-control balance was not represented as proof of unbiased panel crime estimates.
The April 2015 five-reason transferred or cancelled record framework was recorded.
Transferred and cancelled categories were not represented as ordered outcome success or failure measures.
Incidents never recorded as crimes were preserved as outside the transferred or cancelled series.
Absence from the series was not treated as proof that no incident occurred and recording stages remained separate.
Monthly Home Office QA, all-force prepublication confirmation and force resubmission were recorded.
Force verification was not represented as independent record-level audit and later revisions remained possible.
The current year-ending March 2026 workbook, annual prior editions and separate 2006-to-2014 historical ODS were recorded.
Cross-year use retained file-format, schema, edition and field-mapping requirements.
